source.constructor: Use exact F124-AM source-first accepted paired graph birth, changing only cohort and prospectively frozen operator identities, and add third identical-for-both-label one-bit corruption per 24 support pairs. Graph truth unchanged. The first vector also duplicates an extra public demonstration input/output pair to test under-identification.
source.source_truth: Only source evaluator can invert operator and validate one positive, zero negative; old literal path absent; positive/negative public sources identical in token multiset and demos.

Yggdrasil.hypothesis: Robust repeated-source noisy affine learning by fixed-budget RANSAC with explicit confidence abstention can reduce confident-wrong inferences versus F124-AM, but should still fail transparently on out-of-class nonlinear Feistel.
Yggdrasil.inference: Generic 17-coordinate GF(2) elimination and bijective inverse from public support, with 768 deterministic source-blind 17-of-24 subsets; candidate chosen by minimum bit disagreement, tie rejects. Reject map when residual > R or next-best distinct affine model margin below M. No source labels, oracle or operator family names in learner.
Yggdrasil.selection: Maximum exact paired TRAIN accuracy; tie fewest confident incorrect proxy mappings assessed source-only at evaluator (not learner); then fewest false positives; tie conservative lower residual then higher margin. Freeze before DEV.
Yggdrasil.capacity: Original seven active / nine retained fixed. No new persistent cells.
Yggdrasil.limitation: This remains a hand-designed affine-only inductive bias with public supervised example pairs; no unconstrained operation inference or neural causal learning claimed.

Wingless.hypothesis: Test whether the original F124-AM terminal sibling-margin discriminator works at all when operator inference is removed as a confounder.
Wingless.input: Evaluator ONLY supplies certified correctly normalized graph to all Wingless candidates, including gamma0; never report this as an independently learned operator.
Wingless.model: Exact existing original F124-AM terminal_competitive, original AK beta .5, gamma grid 0/.1/.25/.5/1. No model or state tuning; choose gamma on new TRAIN requiring preservation of every gamma0 long-positive case, then maximize paired and minimize FP; tie gamma0.
Wingless.strict_DEV_gate: Per-case long-positive set must contain all gamma0 accepted long positives AND lower FP on same 48 paired DEV to qualify. Preserve negative otherwise.
Wingless.separation: Same new sources as Ygg but distinct Wingless cohorts. Wingless learner/oracle transformation does NOT enter model; source/evaluator-only evaluation conditioned on certified true graph.
